evidence.quote: A VideoCardz source confirmed that one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand, but Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips.
evidence.one_line: Unnamed VideoCardz source says a board partner has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand and Nvidia reportedly put them on hold over 3GB GDDR7 chip prices.
evidence.speaker: VideoCardz unnamed source

evidence.quote: The RTX 50 Super GPUs are rumored to have 3GB GDDR7 chips , which offers 50% more capacity than the 2GB found in current-gen RTX 50-series graphics cards.
evidence.one_line: Reported that RTX 50 Super cards would use 3GB GDDR7 chips, 50% more capacity than the 2GB in current RTX 50 cards.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware (citing rumour)

evidence.quote: the cards expected to be released soon include the RTX 5080 Super, RTX 5070 Ti Super, RTX 5070 Super, and RTX 5050 9GB. The first two will each receive 24GB of GDDR7 VRAM with a 256-bit bus width
evidence.one_line: Per the publication, RTX 5080 Super and RTX 5070 Ti Super each get 24GB GDDR7 on a 256-bit bus; RTX 5070 Super gets 18GB on 192-bit.
evidence.speaker: reported publication

evidence.quote: Unfortunately, these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants, which will likely push the retail price of these cards beyond Nvidia’s envisioned MSRP.
evidence.one_line: Journalist says 3GB GDDR7 chips cost two to three times their 2GB variants, likely pushing Super card prices above Nvidia's MSRP.
evidence.speaker: Jowi Morales

evidence.quote: Nvidia used to supply VRAM chips alongside GPU dies to its board partners, but it changed this policy in late 2025 as the memory chip crisis unfolded.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia stopped supplying VRAM chips with GPU dies to board partners in late 2025, so partners must source memory themselves.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware

evidence.quote: SK hynix, one of the big three memory chip manufacturers, even says that 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.one_line: SK hynix says 2027 will be the worst year for the memory shortage and the crunch will last until 2030.
evidence.speaker: SK hynix

evidence.quote: with the company not announcing a new GPU at CES 2026 . This is the first time this has happened in five years
evidence.one_line: Nvidia announced no new GPU at CES 2026, the first time in five years it had skipped a new GPU at that event.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia

evidence.quote: Its latest AI systems are now more expensive than ever, with memory accounting for 25% of the BOM, as costs have soared by nearly 500%.
evidence.one_line: Latest Nvidia AI systems: memory is 25% of the bill of materials, and memory costs have risen nearly 500%.
evidence.speaker: Tom's Hardware
